alt: Pass rate against completion tokens in log-spaced bins, one line per typical threshold plus the release arm, with a task-count table under the axis
caption: _Pass rate against how long the completion ran, per typical threshold. Cap hits are their own rightmost bin and count as failures. Bins with fewer than three tasks are drawn hollow and left out of the line; the table under the axis gives the task count per bin per series._
label: HumanEval pass rate by completion length

alt: Pass rate against per-request completion tokens per request second in equal-count bins, one line per typical threshold plus the release arm, with a task-count table under the axis
caption: _Pass rate against per-request decode speed, in equal-count bins over the pooled distribution. The eval ran 4 concurrent requests, so this speed is a relative measure under that concurrency, not the single-stream 16K figure. Every cap hit lands in the fastest bin and scores 0, so that bin's dip is a length effect._
label: HumanEval pass rate by per-request decode speed

caption: _Decode rate against task quality, one point per operating point.
